text:
jessica: Quick heads-up — PR #5463 (migration guide + SDK snippet) is ready for review but I'm holding merge until the docs preview and lexicon pass. Looking for reviewers and a merge slot this week.

nate: I can do a pass today. Which parts should I focus on?

jessica: Thanks! Primarily the migration steps and the Python SDK example. Also a quick lexicon check: we switched terminology last quarter (use 'private deployment' not 'on-prem' where appropriate).

emily: tagging in — I'll review voice/tone. Reminder: our style guide prefers active voice and product-first phrasing. Avoid 'we can' and 'you'll' in docs that describe platform capabilities; prefer "Redwood provides" or imperative instructions for user steps.

marco: quick note on terminology: replace "GPU nodes" with "GPU pools" in Dedicated docs; also prefer 'Redwood Dedicated' (proper noun) when referencing the product.

sam: small nit in the code sample — the example uses `client.generate` but new SDK surfaces `client.responses.create`. I'll paste fix.

sam: ```python
# old
resp = client.generate(prompt)
# new
resp = client.responses.create(input=prompt)
```

jessica: great, I'll update the snippet. docs-bot, the preview flagged a link error earlier (404 on /migration/sdk/python). Can we re-run preview after I push the snippet fix?

docs-bot: preview job #879 failed: broken link detected -> /migration/sdk/python -> 404. Re-run available. (See <https://ci.internal/redwood/docs/879>)

emily: Also watch tone in the migration intro paragraph — it currently reads like a blog. Keep it concise and prescriptive: 1) what changed, 2) how to migrate, 3) example.

jessica: updated branch `docs/pr-5463-lexicon-fix` pushed with code snippet + terminology swaps. Re-requesting preview.

docs-bot: preview job #880 started. Expected ~3m.

nate: I'll check links and headings while the preview runs. Heads-up: merge window tomorrow 15:00 PT — if preview is green and emily + marco sign off, can we merge then?

emily: I can sign off by 12:00 PT tomorrow if there are no more blocks. Quick checklist: code samples run locally, no marketing-y phrasing, product names capitalized, and migration steps numbered.

marco: will check Dedicated/Dedicated -> Dedicated wording and confirm.

docs-bot: preview job #880 succeeded. No new broken links detected.

jessica: awesome :party_parrot: — thanks all. I'll wait for emily + marco and merge in the 15:00 PT slot assuming no late comments. If anything urgent, drop here or ping @jessica.

emily: LGTM, pushing a small wording tweak (imperative form). :thumbsup:

marco: LGTM for terminology.

jessica: merging at 15:05 PT since CI and approvals are green. Thanks everyone!

nate: thanks — will monitor docs preview after merge for the live site.
